errors.error_description: Used case equality (===) in synthesizable RTL to check address alignment, which is non-synthesizable and operator misuse.
Created an always_comb block that conditionally assigns byte_mask without a default or else branch, inferring a latch.
Instantiated a sub-module with a port width mismatch by connecting a wider addr bus to a narrower input port.
Used a level-sensitive always @(clk) block to drive sequential state (valid_q), mixing combinational sensitivity with sequential behavior.
